must_show: Isolated SAST finding nodes leading to backlog bloat and 90-day SLA
Linear multi-step attack chain combining API Key, TLS bypass, and token storage
Direct contrast between theoretical noise and validated exploitability

caption: Chaining theoretical findings into a validated attack path converts a 90-day remediation backlog into an urgent 7-day security fix.

heading: Mapping OWASP MASTG Controls into Directed Graph Attack Pathways
core_technical_idea: Chaining independent, low-severity MASTG vulnerabilities (resilience, network, storage) into an automated directed graph attack path leading to account takeover.
must_show: MASVS-RESILIENCE-1 node allowing Frida-server instrumentation
MASVS-NETWORK-1 node enabling TLS interception and endpoint rebind
MASVS-STORAGE-1 node yielding heap memory and sandbox token extraction
Directed edges forming an automated data exfiltration and account takeover chain
composition: A left-to-right directed acyclic graph showing state transitions from initial instrumentation to final data exfiltration, highlighting how individual checks compound in severity.
alt_text: Directed graph showing MASTG controls mapped as nodes: MASVS-RESILIENCE-1 transitions via Frida to MASVS-NETWORK-1 TLS bypass, culminating in MASVS-STORAGE-1 token extraction and account takeover.
caption: Chaining discrete control failures transforms isolated medium-risk MASTG findings into a fully automated exploit pathway.

heading: Structuring Mobile AppSec Metrics Around Exploitability Cost
